Legal Studies Worksheet Maker

For teachers. Make a printable practice sheet: choose the syllabus content and skills, mix past HSC questions with new questions, scenarios, key terms, evidence tasks and TEEACL paragraphs, then set out the page and download the PDF with its answer copy.

Write new questions with Claude

Claude can write new questions in the same style as the ones on your worksheet, for any dot point. On this website it uses a teacher’s own Anthropic API key, kept in this browser only.

More like my worksheet copies the style of the questions already on your worksheet for the dot point (or of past HSC questions on it, if there are none yet): the same types, marks and verbs, with new scenarios and data. Check Claude’s questions before you print: they are not from NESA and have not been reviewed.
